method: Sequential persistent loopback HTTP requests alternating between release Rust Tauri and production Flask routes in Waitress. RSS covers the entire server process and excludes children. 500 sentences per archive, with full production rollups. Samples include job acceptance, execution and polling at 2 ms intervals. Every round compares the complete sentence records and exchanges ZIPs between runtimes before restoring. Vacuum reclaims a disposable 1 MiB allocation. The fixture also verifies mutual exclusion with a separate process.
